```yaml
name: Publish Bulk CDK Extract Package

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '21'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3

      - name: Validate Extract Version
        run: |
          cd airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/extract
          if [ ! -f "version.properties" ]; then
            echo "Error: version.properties file not found in extract module"
            exit 1
          fi
          EXTRACT_VERSION=$(grep "^version=" version.properties | cut -d'=' -f2)
          echo "Extract version: $EXTRACT_VERSION"
          if [ -z "$EXTRACT_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Error: No version found in version.properties"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "EXTRACT_VERSION=$EXTRACT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Publish Extract Package
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:extract:extractCdkPublish
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
          GPG_PASSPHRASE: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}
```
